sentences.text: The petitioner is the 2nd accused in Crime No.701 of 2020 of Chottanikkara Police Station.
He filed this Crl.M.C under Section 528 BNSS praying for quashing all further proceedings against him.
The offence alleged as against the 1 st accused are under Section 376(2)(n) IPC is alleged.
However, as against the petitioner, the offence under Section 67(A) of the IT Act alone is alleged.
2. The prosecution case that the petitioner has sent nude photos of the 1st accused and the de facto complainant to the husband of the de facto complainant.
2. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, this is a false case foisted against the petitioner.
Moreover, according to the learned counsel, now the entire dispute between the petitioner and the de facto complainant has been settled.
Therefore, he prayed for quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner.
3. The learned counsel for the 2nd respondent/de facto complainant also submitted that, now the entire dispute between the petitioner and the de facto complainant has been settled.
Therefore, he also prayed for quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner.
4. The petition was opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.

Sreelakshmy vs State Of Kerala on 26 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123415852/
2

5. On a perusal of the judgment of the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Ernakulam in SC No.1044 of 2022, it can be seen that, when the de facto complainant was examined as PW1, she turned hostile to the prosecution and deposed that she was not intimidated or raped by the 1st accused.
It was in the above context, the learned Sessions Judge acquitted the 1st accused.
6. In the above circumstance, there is no meaning in continuing the proceedings against the petitioner.
Moreover, now the entire dispute between the petitioner and the de facto complainant has been settled and she has filed an affidavit to that effect.
Therefore this Crl.M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No.701 of 2020 of Chottanikkara Police Station, is quashed under Section 528 of B.N.S.S. Sd/-
C.
